headline: FHA foreclosures
*highest since 2017*
slides.fig_caption: Share of FHA loans in foreclosure, Q3 2026

slides.title: Delinquency by *loan type*
slides.note: Versus a year ago: FHA is up *0.96 points*, VA up 0.50 and conventional up just 0.11. VA foreclosures (1.06%) are the highest since late 2016.

slides.label: of loans are *seriously delinquent*
slides.body: That means 90+ days late or in foreclosure. The share is up 0.51 points in a year and has climbed five straight quarters. Overall delinquency: 4.42%, up from 3.99%.

slides.title: Strain, *not a crisis*
slides.body: Delinquencies are near pre-pandemic levels and conventional loans are holding up. The pressure is in FHA and VA loans, so expect more owners who need a sale plan before foreclosure.
